t:abstract.t:p: Miracles of Zarʾa Buruk which form part of his hagiographic dossier. The number of miracles may vary from the core transmission of 26 miracles to 42 or more in other versions. The inclusion of a significantly greater number of miracles may have occurred due to the merging of traditions relating to another saint with the same name.
